q: How much electricity and CO2 does a Kishangarh marble processing unit use per square metre?
title: Kishangarh marble: CO2 per sq m
short: Divide monthly kWh by square metres of finished slab or tile, then multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. A unit using 50,000 kWh to finish 20,000 square metres runs at 2.5 kWh and about 1.8 kg CO2 per square metre. Gangsaws and polishing lines take most of it.
audience: Marble and granite processing units in Kishangarh and Makrana

p: Diesel for generators and loaders, and quarry or transport emissions if a buyer asks for cradle to gate.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including kVAh, demand and solar export lines, into dated records with the units, factor and year behind every Scope 2 figure.

example.title: Example: one month
lines: 50,000 kWh ÷ 20,000 sq m = 2.5 kWh per sq m
